verdict.score_rationale: The board sits between the 5 and 6 anchors: its flow is readable and regionally composed, but extensive plain-box vocabulary, oversized empty areas, and awkward long feedback routes keep it from reading as a finished artifact.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The four-stage upper flow uses the width well, but the oversized telemetry region and broad lower-center expanse create conspicuous dead bands.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Pastel containers provide coherent grouping and red lifecycle feedback is meaningful, but the gray process treatment dominates where agent/reviewer and other registry-specific colors should appear.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junctions are visible, but the very long dashed red and blue return routes, edge-hugging turns, and small pill labels expose routing mechanics.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The five reviewer boxes form a strong aligned register and the main pipeline is clear, but scattered note cards, underfilled lower panels, and long isolated routes disrupt the overall rhythm.
